notes.title: ver0.3.0 - Major Update
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update[/h1][p]A brand new [b]Combo System[/b] has been added in this update![/p][p]By landing multiple spells and skills, you can temporarily power up your character!
We’ve also added several new symbols and made some balance adjustments.[/p][p]Enjoy the new content![/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h2]Additions[/h2][h3]New Feature[/h3][list][*][p]Combo[/p][list][*][p]Each time a spell or skill hits, your combo count increases.[/p][list][*][p]Some spells add 1 combo only upon activation.[/p][/*][*][p]AoE (area-of-effect) attacks add only 1 combo in total.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Every [b]10 combos[/b] increases your damage on the current floor by [b]+5%[/b].[/p][list][*][p]Combo count resets when you move to the next floor.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][/p][h3]Symbols[/h3][list][*][p]Items (2 types):[/p][list][*][p]COMBO CORN[/p][/*][*][p]GAMING COIN[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Spells (6 new [h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Adjusted to prevent tooltip display overlap from the mouse cursor when using a controller

　- A warning message will appear if resources are insufficient

notes.content:
[h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2]
[list]

[*]Added "POISON 2" effect to the abilities of the enemies CRAB and SCORPION.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Changed the following keyboard key bindings:
　- [Toggle Details]: H → F
　- [Inventory]: I → E
　- [Investigation Mode Toggle]: G → R
[*]Adjusted various UI elements.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the game to force quit when loading save data with errors after selecting "Continue".
　- We have confirmed that selecting "Continue" after the forced shutdown allows the game to resume normally.
　- This is a temporary measure to prevent progression with faulty data.
　- Please wait a little longer for a fundamental fix.
[/list]

notes.title: 'Ranking Reset' and 'Data Deletion' in the Next Update
notes.content:
Hello, players!
This is an announcement from the "Slot & Dungeons" development team.

As part of the upcoming major update "ver0.1.0," we plan to [b]delete the current "ranking data"[/b]. This update includes significant balance adjustments, and we hope you will enjoy the ranking feature in the new environment.

Additionally, after applying this update, any [b]remaining interrupted data will be deleted[/b] when you launch "Slot & Dungeons." We kindly ask for your understanding in advance.

"ver0.1.0" will include many new symbols, adjustments, and the arrival of new enemies, making "Slot & Dungeons" even more fun and exciting! We hope you look forward to it!

The "Slot & Dungeons" Development Team
